room_description: A dimly lit home office or study containing a desk with a laptop, a wooden bookshelf, a patterned chaise lounge, an overturned chair, and a wastebasket.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the office room.
Moving the sofa cushion to find a silver key.
Using the key to unlock the bookshelf drawer, revealing a green box cutter.
Opening the desk drawer to collect a USB flash drive.
Plugging the USB drive into the laptop to activate the screen.
Examining the black notebook to see a grid of red numbers.
Unfolding the crumpled paper on the desk to reveal a grid with red dots.
Entering the derived PIN code into the laptop.
Completing the 'Quickspot' minigame on the laptop.
Entering '311' into the desk drawer lock and escaping with the key.

solution_steps: Open the unlocked desk drawer to get the USB drive.
Insert it into the laptop to bring up the keypad screen.
Examine the crumpled paper to see the positions of 5 red dots.
Cross-reference these positions with the grid of numbers in the black notebook.
Extract the corresponding numbers to form the code.
Play the 'Quickspot' game on the laptop.
Find and click all 5 differences between the two classic portraits.
Look at the combination lock on the lower desk drawer.
Enter the code '311' provided by the laptop.

final_action: The player uses the silver key from the locked desk drawer to open the main door and escape the room.
